sages.name: MELCHIOR
sages.notes: Claude Code headless. Prompt is piped via stdin. .result holds the final text. Default scope preserves configured tools. Confidential scope appends a Web-only allowlist; keep that variadic isolation_args field last.

sages.name: BALTHASAR
sages.notes: Runs through the bundled codex-sage.sh wrapper. Default scope passes arguments transparently to codex exec and preserves configured tools. Confidential scope makes the wrapper disable MCP servers, plugins and apps fail-closed. cli stays 'codex' because that is what preflight must find. The prompt arrives on stdin via the trailing '-'; the final message goes to ANSWER_FILE.

sages.name: CASPER
sages.notes: Grok Build headless. Prompt is passed as a file path. schema_args is appended when the host supplies a schema. permission-mode auto is required because nobody can answer an approval prompt. Default scope preserves configured tools. Confidential scope limits built-ins to search and fetch and denies MCP calls; schemas may remain visible while calls are refused.
